findings.summary: No single declaration states Lemma 9.2. Its four clauses are separate theorems in four files, and in the WaveInteractionBounds encoding clause (i) needs a bound and a product identity read together before it says anything about the product.

Lean's WaveClass and MeanClass are only the jet-bound half of Definitions 6.5 and 6.4. The θ-independence, supp ⊂ Ω_γ and smooth-zero-extension clauses of W-membership live outside the class, in the separate predicate NonzeroSupported.

In the WaveInteractionBounds encoding clauses (ii) and (iii) are stated for one ordered product at a time; the paper's symmetric sum is two applications plus MemClass.add. The harmonic encoding symmetrizes the wave part but not the zero harmonic.

Lean turns the paper's standing context into explicit hypotheses — κ ≤ 1/2, BandBound (-1/2) on frequency and angular frequency, ζ ≤ 1, 0 ≤ P ≤ 1, zero stored mode, finite band — and replaces 'curl-generated' by mode solenoidality, which is weaker.
